svg.title: OTGW agentic workshop: architecture at a glance
svg.desc: Overview poster of the OTGW agentic development setup as of 2026-11-15: people and decision rights, channels, BlueFlame Bot and its three watch loops, sessions and agents, rule layers and how they are enforced, the knowledge base, the ADR kit, the pipeline with its gates, what ships, external sources and key numbers.
svg.text: OTGW agentic workshop: architecture at a glance
two decide · the others bring input and evidence
issues, PRs, forum posts become tasks
no effect on the bot · answered once
Push to dev and the 1.x line
Stable release · push to main · force-push
PIC flash · merging another person's PR
commands: early exit if checked < 5 min ago
open issues and PRs via gh, as maintainer
no early exit · deduplicated on the URL
early exit if all three checked < 2 h ago
Never names the 2.x gateway board in public
Boiler or thermostat question: equipment matrix first
SAT claim: thermo-nova citation + register check
Technical claims verified in the code first
Zip post pings no one and must match HEAD
reads knowledge · writes register and notes
push only after the bench OK
picks tasks · owns DM and ledger
OTA first · ticks the bench ACs
189 lines, test limit 230 · wins on conflict
10 binding, each names a gate · rest: review
backlog guard blocks Edit and Write, not Bash
post-edit evaluate returns the FAIL lines
no bump or no TASK id: commit rejected
the adr-judge pass is off by default
String in hot paths only warns
build lock: one build, at most 4 jobs
post script: the zip must come from HEAD
the reviewer team is told to refute

hard stops · wrapper build · DM route

Codex and Copilot do not load .claude/rules.
In the repo the hard stops are convention:
no hook guards a push to main or a force-push.

docs · which component owns which code
Never self-accepted · content immutable after acceptance
CI gate on push to dev
Of the 10 binding ADRs: 4 gated in CI · 4 by local tests or build · 2 through adr-judge

or TASK id without its file
